scope: Selected live equipment publication; Unity 2021.3.6f1 Windows x64 Mono. No new public release or physical-device acceptance.
publicRawPolicy: Exact gameplay observations and intended fault assertion lines are included. Full local Unity logs remain private because they contain machine and licensing diagnostics.

initialFailures.workspaceTemp: The first broad check failed while bundling a consumer in the restricted profile temp folder. The retained final run uses an owned workspace temp directory.
initialFailures.unityAccess: The restricted first editor launch failed its existing machine licence check before loading the project. The unchanged packages passed with normal local access; licence files were not changed.
